thread:
nora: quick thought — for the playground run history, what if we show a compact "glance" row that prioritizes human summary + tool breadcrumb, and hides raw JSON unless expanded?

devin: +1. users scan dozens of runs; collapsing long tool outputs helps. proposal: glance row = summary (editable) + micro-breadcrumb e.g. 'OCR · Translate(1) · APIcall' + tiny metrics chevron.

ash: accessibility: make the glance row a single tab stop and when expanded move focus into the expanded region. announce via aria-live: 'Run expanded, 3 tool calls'. avoid focus traps.

mike: stream edge-case: functions with stream:true should show a progressive summary line like 'translating... (partial)' and a spinner. snapshots saved so final collapse replaces partial text.

nora: for function defs, show param name + inline type pill; hover opens full type docs. simple schema example in mock:
```
text: string
lang: enum(en,es,fr)
opts.timeout_ms: int
```

devin: nested tool calls — show a small depth indicator '↳ x2' and 'contains nested calls' label. expand to reveal collapsible tree instead of raw JSON.

ash: copy nit: avoid "tokens" in main list. use 'units used' or hide it behind metrics. also make badges low contrast by default, high-contrast in accessibility mode.

aria-bot: telemetry suggestion: emit events playground.run.expand, playground.run.inline_edit, playground.run.stream_snapshot with run_id and user_id.

mike: final checklist before mocks: 1) keyboard nav 2) visible focus ring on expand/collapse 3) screen reader announcements for partial updates 4) collapse heuristics for long outputs 5) metrics chevron for advanced stats.

nora: i'll prepare two mocks (glance + expanded-tree) and include a long nested tool output sample so eng can test collapse heuristics. tagging @devin @ash for review. :eyes:
